meta.name: hunt-captcha-bypass
meta.description: Hunt CAPTCHA Bypass — 6 distinct patterns: (1) CAPTCHA field simply omitted from the request (server-side validation absent), (2) CAPTCHA token replayed from a solved challenge (no single-use enforcement), (3) CAPTCHA response accepted on a different endpoint than it was solved on (no binding to action/session), (4) static or predictable CAPTCHA values accepted (e.g. '0', 'null', empty string), (5) audio/accessibility CAPTCHA trivially solvable programmatically, (6) CAPTCHA only enforced after N failures (first N requests bypass it). Detection: intercept a successful form submission, remove the CAPTCHA field entirely, replay — if it still succeeds, server-side validation is absent. Medium severity standalone; High when it removes the only rate-limit gate protecting a login, registration, or payment endpoint.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检测并利用验证码绕过漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在安全评估中测试验证码机制的有效性。
copy.tagline_en: Detect and exploit CAPTCHA bypass vulnerabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to test the effectiveness of CAPTCHA mechanisms during security assessments.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你测试网站验证码（CAPTCHA）是否存在漏洞，比如直接去掉验证码字段、重复使用同一个验证码令牌等，并给出检测结果。
howto.when: 当你需要检查一个网站表单（如登录、注册、密码重置）的验证码是否真的被服务器验证时触发。

say.text: 帮我测试这个登录页面的验证码能否直接省略。
say.note: Claude 会尝试提交不带验证码字段的请求，看是否成功。

say.text: 检查这个注册接口的验证码令牌能否重复使用。
say.note: Claude 会先完成一次验证，再用同一令牌提交第二次。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you test if a website's CAPTCHA has vulnerabilities, such as omitting the CAPTCHA field entirely or replaying a previously solved token, and report the results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to check if a website form (e.g., login, registration, password reset) actually validates the CAPTCHA on the server side.

say_en.text: Test if the CAPTCHA on this login page can be omitted.
Check if the CAPTCHA token on this registration endpoint can be reused.
say_en.note: Claude will solve the CAPTCHA once, then submit the same token again.
